messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: ALERT fired — multiple p99 latency breaches in eu-west cluster. Rule: p99 >= 1200ms for 5m. Alert id: PD-78122.
Priya (oncall): Acked. i'm on it. pulling dashboards now.
Priya (oncall): p95 ~ 420ms, p99 ~ 1.4s across eu-west-api-prod for last 5m. traffic up ~1.8x to model-serving.
Jamie (infra): seeing increased queue depth on frontend edge for eu-west (queue_consumer_lag spike). KV-cache hit-rate dropped from 92% -> 54%. possible cache thrash.
Chris (runtime): any recent model rollouts in eu-west?
Priya (oncall): no model rollouts in last 24h. there was a traffic routing experiment at 09:10UTC (small canary) — @Jamie?
Jamie (infra): canary was traffic-weight change to try new autoscaler policy (10:30UTC) — brief ramp. looked stable then. showing many reclaim events on pods around 11:45UTC.
Alex (sre): I see GPU pod preemptions in cloud logs around 11:44: node autoscaler scaled down then up quickly. possible thrash causing KV cache cold starts.
Chris (runtime): KV entries being evicted will amplify latency for long-tail requests (cache miss -> full model fetch). can we force warm keys for high-qps endpoints?
Priya (oncall): running: `curl -XPOST https://admin.internal/evict-protect -d '{"pattern":"/models/*/hot"}'` to pin hot keys, will monitor.
incident-bot: Command executed by Priya (oncall): protect hot-key set applied.
Priya (oncall): after protect, hit-rate climbed to 72% but p99 still ~1.1s.
Jamie (infra): scaling more capacity now (manual bump + add 3 replicas to eu-west-gpu-pool).
Megan (cs): any user-visible errors? support channel quiet so far, but a few slow complaints flagged to Linda.
Linda (support): i have two customer reports about slow document summaries in EU. they are degraded but responses eventually succeed. asking for interim note.
Megan (cs): drafting quick customer update: "We're aware of increased response times for EU customers; we're mitigating and will update in 30m." want to post once we confirm impact window.
Chris (runtime): also seeing bursty KV rebuilds from sidecars — need to reduce concurrency on rebuild path. I'll push a throttle patch to sidecar config: `max_rebuild_concurrency=4`.
Priya (oncall): can you patch and roll small sidecar restart? we need low-risk change.
Chris (runtime): pushing config change to staging then canary to 10% traffic in eu-west. rolling now.
incident-bot: Deploy started by Chris (runtime): sidecar throttle patch. Deploy id: D-9921.
Jamie (infra): while deploy goes, manually rerouting 15% of eu-west traffic to eu-central as temporary fallback via routing policy `fallback-weight:15%`.
Priya (oncall): noted. watch metrics for eu-central saturating.
Alex (sre): alert note: PD-78122 escalates in 8m if unacked by next layer. Priya — want to hand off if you need to step out?
Priya (oncall): i'll remain primary for next 20 min, then i'll handoff to Alex (sre) if still ongoing.
Megan (cs): customer note ready. Linda, you can send when Priya confirms 1st mitigation step applied.
Linda (support): copy.
Chris (runtime): canary patch is applied to 10% — early signs: sidecar rebuild rate down 40%, KV hit-rate improved on canary pods.
Priya (oncall): metrics: eu-west overall KV hit-rate 78% after recent fixes, p99 trending down to ~750ms. great.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Alert PD-78122 status: acknowledged by Priya (oncall).
Jamie (infra): manual scale completed, new replicas healthy. no sign of node preemptions now.
Alex (sre): i'm standing by for handoff in 20m. set a reminder at 1769994923.
Priya (oncall): handoff plan: if p99 < 900ms and KV hit-rate > 75% for 10m, we close PD. otherwise escalate and continue mitigation.
Megan (cs): customer note sent.
Linda (support): sent to impacted accounts. one asked for ETA, replied we'll update in 30m.
Chris (runtime): follow-up: schedule a postmortem action — add guardrail to prevent autoscaler downscale under bursty queue conditions.
Jamie (infra): agree. filing infra ticket INF-5489.
Priya (oncall): p99 now 620ms, p95 360ms. i'm going to start preparing the incident summary.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Alert PD-78122 will resolve automatically if no further trigger in 10m.
Priya (oncall): continuing to monitor for the handoff. thanks all :thumbsup:
Alex (sre): taking over if it persists. ping me directly.
Megan (cs): good job team.
